metadata.title: Auditable Simulation Settings & Stratum Specifications for Invertebrate Laser Biophotonics
metadata.audit_standard: ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English & Empirical Tissue Optics Standard

governing_authorities.citation: Cuesta & Lobo (2019) Spectrophotometric measurements of beetle elytra. PeerJ 7:e8104
governing_authorities.scope: Macroscopic reflectance (R), transmittance (T), and absorbance (A) across 185-1400 nm in Onthophagus dung beetle elytra.

governing_authorities.citation: Prahl (1999) Optical properties of hemoglobin. Oregon Medical Laser Center (OMLC)
governing_authorities.scope: Reference/calibration benchmark for comparative validation; strictly 0% in insect models per tracheal respiration biology.

governing_authorities.citation: Jacques (2013) Optical properties of biological tissues: a review. Phys. Med. Biol. 58:R37
governing_authorities.scope: Melanin absorption power-law, cellular background baseline, Rayleigh-Mie dual scattering parameterisation.

beetle_elytron.anatomical_aspect: Dorsal Elytral Armour over Subelytral Air Cavity into Visceral Mass
beetle_elytron.description: Melanised sclerotised chitinous exocuticle acting as an optical shield, suspended over an insulating subelytral air cavity with a 0.25 mm diameter dorsal hemolymph vessel buried at exactly 1.0 mm depth.
beetle_elytron.empirical_grounding: Stratum thicknesses and baseline reflectance/transmittance grounded by Cuesta & Lobo (2019) PeerJ 7:e8104 spectrophotometry of Onthophagus dung beetle elytra (82-100 µm total cuticle thickness). Hemolymph model grounded by insect physiological biochemistry (water 93%, protein 7%, 0% hemoglobin).

buried_blood_vessel.note: Insects possess open circulation with aqueous hemolymph; zero hemoglobin.

beetle_ventral.anatomical_aspect: Ventral Thoracic / Abdominal Intersegmental Membrane into Muscle
beetle_ventral.description: Thin unarmored cuticle without an insulating subelytral air gap, with direct optical and thermal coupling into the ventral visceral mass and a 0.25 mm blood vessel at 1.0 mm depth.
beetle_ventral.empirical_grounding: Grounded by comparative cuticle thinning in ventral beetle somites and soft intersegmental membranes.

buried_blood_vessel.note: Insects possess open circulation with aqueous hemolymph; zero hemoglobin.

larva.taxonomic_classification: Lepidoptera / Coleoptera larvae (e.g. Spodoptera frugiperda, Helicoverpa zea)
larva.anatomical_aspect: Dorsal Translucent Body Wall into Gut Lumen
larva.description: Soft unsclerotised body wall (85% water) with foliar gut contents (chlorophyll-a/b) and a 0.25 mm dorsal blood vessel at 1.0 mm depth.
larva.empirical_grounding: Grounded by plant chlorophyll pigment absorption spectra (Soret peak 430 nm, Q-band 665 nm) and larval body wall spectrophotometry.

buried_blood_vessel.note: Insects possess open circulation with aqueous hemolymph; zero hemoglobin.

snail.anatomical_aspect: Mineralised Calcareous Shell over Mantle Cavity Air Gap into Muscular Foot
snail.description: Crossed-lamellar aragonite mineral shell (extreme Mie scattering, a'=140 cm^-1) providing photon diffusion armor over an air gap and visceral mass containing hemocyanin.
snail.empirical_grounding: Grounded by aragonite CaCO3 biomineral optics and gastropod copper-based hemocyanin respiratory pigment.

buried_blood_vessel.note: Gastropods possess an open hemocoel with hemocyanin, not a closed red blood vessel plexus.

slug.anatomical_aspect: Sacrificial Surface Mucus Film over Mantle Dermis into Visceral Mass
slug.description: Softest biophotonic target: 94-96% water throughout, with a sacrificial hydrated mucus surface layer, no mineral shell, and direct visceral exposure.
slug.empirical_grounding: Grounded by molluscan mucin optical dispersion and high water fraction (94-96%) thermodynamics.

buried_blood_vessel.note: Hemolymph sinus distribution throughout parenchyma without discrete closed 0.25 mm hemoglobin vessel.
